additionalContext: Feature-Crew is installed. When a request asks to build, fix, change, refactor, implement, add, or extend code, invoke /fc-build-or-fix before editing: it sizes the track, so small fixes stay fast. If a task grows mid-way, such as a new repository, a refactor, or a release, pause and route the new scope through /fc-build-or-fix instead of continuing inline. Use /fc-ship to push, watch CI, merge, release, and clean up, and /fc-review before pushing work that skipped the pipeline. Questions that change no code need none of this.
